final: {"prompt":"A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting filling the entire image edge to edge. Express the tension between proliferating possibilities and a precise commitment through paint alone. Concentrate layered ultramarine, midnight violet, and charcoal into an uneven, turbulent density slightly off center. Let thin, interrupted strokes of vermilion and luminous coral push through this mass, sometimes buried beneath translucent glazes, sometimes sharply exposed. Surround the density with generous areas of warm ivory and pale mineral gray, subtly worked rather than flat. Build rhythms of tentative marks, repetitions with small deviations, abrupt erasures, and passages where many gestures resolve into one decisive sweep. Contrast dry, dragging brushwork with thick impasto ridges, scraped cavities, soft pigment blooms, and delicate stains. Keep the composition asymmetrical, suspended between compression and release; let the quietest area exert as much force as the most saturated passage. Every mark remains abstract and irregular. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
